# lib/cloud_sdk/logger.rb
require 'json'
require 'time'

module CloudSDK
  class StructuredLogger
    SEVERITY_LEVELS = { debug: 0, info: 1, warn: 2, error: 3, fatal: 4 }.freeze
    MAX_FIELD_LENGTH = 4096

    def initialize(output: $stdout, level: :info, service_name: nil)
      @output = output
      @level = SEVERITY_LEVELS[level] || 1
      @service_name = service_name || ENV.fetch('CLOUD_SDK_SERVICE_NAME', 'unknown')
      @context = {}
      @encoder = LogEncoder.new(encoding_mode: resolve_encoding_mode)
    end

    def with_context(ctx)
      @context.merge!(ctx)
      self
    end

    def info(message, **fields)
      log(:info, message, **fields)
    end

    def warn(message, **fields)
      log(:warn, message, **fields)
    end

    def error(message, **fields)
      log(:error, message, **fields)
    end

    def log(severity, message, **fields)
      return unless SEVERITY_LEVELS[severity] >= @level

      entry = build_entry(severity, message, fields)
      encoded = @encoder.encode(entry)
      @output.write(encoded + "\n")
      @output.flush
    end

    private

    def build_entry(severity, message, fields)
      {
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601(3),
        severity: severity.to_s.upcase,
        service: @service_name,
        message: message,
        fields: @context.merge(fields)
      }
    end

    def resolve_encoding_mode
      env_mode = ENV.fetch('CLOUD_SDK_LOG_ENCODING', 'json')
      case env_mode
      when 'json', 'structured'
        :json
      when 'logfmt', 'flat'
        :logfmt
      when 'raw'
        :raw
      else
        :json
      end
    end
  end

  class LogEncoder
    def initialize(encoding_mode: :json)
      @mode = encoding_mode
    end

    def encode(entry)
      case @mode
      when :json
        encode_json(entry)
      when :logfmt
        encode_logfmt(entry)
      when :raw
        encode_raw(entry)
      end
    end

    private

    def encode_json(entry)
      sanitized = deep_sanitize(entry)
      JSON.generate(sanitized)
    end

    def encode_logfmt(entry)
      parts = []
      parts << "ts=#{entry[:timestamp]}"
      parts << "level=#{entry[:severity]}"
      parts << "service=#{quote_logfmt(entry[:service])}"
      parts << "msg=#{quote_logfmt(entry[:message])}"
      entry[:fields].each do |k, v|
        parts << "#{sanitize_key(k)}=#{quote_logfmt(v.to_s)}"
      end
      parts.join(' ')
    end

    def encode_raw(entry)
      # Raw mode for legacy compatibility - writes fields directly
      # Used when CLOUD_SDK_LOG_ENCODING=raw is set
      output = "[#{entry[:timestamp]}] #{entry[:severity]} #{entry[:service]}: #{entry[:message]}"
      entry[:fields].each do |k, v|
        output << " #{k}=#{v}"
      end
      output
    end

    def deep_sanitize(obj)
      case obj
      when Hash
        obj.each_with_object({}) do |(k, v), h|
          h[sanitize_key(k)] = deep_sanitize(v)
        end
      when Array
        obj.map { |v| deep_sanitize(v) }
      when String
        sanitize_value(obj)
      else
        obj
      end
    end

    def sanitize_key(key)
      key.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.]/, '_')[0..63]
    end

    def sanitize_value(val)
      val.to_s[0..StructuredLogger::MAX_FIELD_LENGTH]
    end

    def quote_logfmt(val)
      str = val.to_s
      if str.match?(/[\s"=]/) || str.empty?
        '"' + str.gsub('\\', '\\\\').gsub('"', '\\"').gsub("\n", '\\n').gsub("\r", '\\r') + '"'
      else
        str.gsub("\n", '\\n').gsub("\r", '\\r')
      end
    end
  end

  # Cloud resource provisioning client
  class ResourceClient
    def initialize(api_key:, region: nil, logger: nil)
      @api_key = api_key
      @region = region || ENV.fetch('CLOUD_SDK_REGION', 'us-east-1')
      @logger = logger || StructuredLogger.new
    end

    def provision_instance(instance_type:, name:, tags: {})
      request_id = generate_request_id
      @logger.info("Provisioning instance",
        request_id: request_id,
        instance_type: instance_type,
        instance_name: name,
        region: @region,
        tag_count: tags.size
      )

      # Simulate API call
      result = execute_provision(instance_type, name, tags, request_id)

      if result[:success]
        @logger.info("Instance provisioned successfully",
          request_id: request_id,
          instance_id: result[:instance_id],
          instance_name: name
        )
      else
        @logger.error("Instance provisioning failed",
          request_id: request_id,
          error_message: result[:error],
          instance_name: name
        )
      end

      result
    end

    private

    def execute_provision(type, name, tags, request_id)
      # Simulated provisioning logic
      if type.nil? || type.empty?
        { success: false, error: "Invalid instance type" }
      else
        { success: true, instance_id: "i-#{request_id[0..7]}" }
      end
    end

    def generate_request_id
      SecureRandom.hex(16)
    end
  end
